name: SOC-HomeLab
blurb: A two-VM detection lab: Suricata IDS and Zeek watching the same interface, Wazuh as the SIEM, Grafana and Loki for hunting. Custom Suricata rules, a scripted attack simulation with a beacon-detection script, and a real 24-hour threat hunt through the SIEM's own alert volume.

name: Threat-Intel-Sentinel
blurb: Threat intelligence run end to end in Microsoft Sentinel: inventory the built-in feeds with KQL, mine 220 brute force IPs from my own logs, turn them into STIX indicators with a standard-library Python script, match them against logons, network flows and 90 days of history, then prove a file hash rule with EICAR and wire three analytics rules.

name: Threat-Hunting-Casebook
blurb: A growing casebook of threat hunts reconstructed from raw telemetry with KQL, one folder per incident with the same file set every time. Incident 01 traces a Microsoft 365 Copilot prompt injection from one poisoned email to 13 exposed files and image-link exfiltration, with ATT&CK and ATLAS mapping, five detections and a formal report.

name: Win11-STIG-Remediations
blurb: Ten DISA Windows 11 STIG findings from a credentialed Tenable scan, each fixed by hand, undone to prove the scanner catches it, then fixed again with an idempotent PowerShell script. Caught a Group Policy audit.csv side effect that silently disabled 13 audit checks. Failed checks 151 to 140, no regressions.

name: Py-ConfigBackup
blurb: A Netmiko CLI that SSHes into every device in an inventory file, backs up the running config, diffs it against the last backup, and emails an alert only when something changed. Tested against a real two-router VyOS lab built with containerlab, which caught two bugs a mocked test suite never could.

name: Py-SubnetCalc
blurb: A dependency-free Python CLI that plans VLSM subnetting from a CSV of departments and host counts using the ipaddress standard library. 30 tests, and an allocation order that stops wasted address space.

name: Wireshark-Captures
blurb: Nine real packet captures: DNS, TCP, HTTP vs HTTPS, ICMP, packet loss, ARP, DHCP, Telnet vs SSH, and FTP. Each one generated, read, and explained by hand for CCNA study.

name: Vuln-Mgmt-Program
blurb: A vulnerability management program from policy to remediation: stakeholder buy-in, Tenable scanning across Windows and Linux targets, and ten confirmed fixes in PowerShell and Bash, including the two attempts that didn't work out.

name: Linux-Hardening-Audit
blurb: Lynis and rkhunter against a real Ubuntu workstation: three warnings triaged, a crashed Fail2ban jail caught, and an honest account of the thirty eight suggestions I skipped.

name: AD-HomeLab
blurb: Active Directory on Windows Server 2022: OU design, Fine-Grained Password Policies, Windows LAPS, delegated help desk rights, WSUS patching, scripted provisioning, and a backup I actually tested.

name: M365-Identity-Ops
blurb: Onboarding, offboarding, groups, delegated admin roles, mail flow, and service health, automated with the Microsoft Graph PowerShell SDK, with a real audit trail.

name: ITSM-ServiceDesk-Sim
blurb: A Freshservice service desk built from scratch: three SLA tiers, a category taxonomy, a service catalog, and twenty simulated helpdesk tickets modeled on a real support queue.

name: IT-Runbook-SOPs
blurb: A five-document IT runbook covering onboarding, offboarding, password reset, laptop setup, and network troubleshooting, built from NIST, CIS Controls v8, and Microsoft's own documentation.

name: M365-Admin-Lab
blurb: A Microsoft 365 test tenant on the path that is actually open to individuals, the 30-day E3 trial: users across three departments, MFA switched on before anything else, and the cancellation step that avoids the bill.

name: Enterprise-Lab-CML
blurb: An enterprise network lab built in Cisco Modeling Labs (CML) on real Cisco IOS images instead of a simulator: core, distribution and access layers, VLANs, routing and redundancy, documented with the full topology, addressing plan and verification commands.

name: CCNP-Security-Notes
blurb: Lecture notes in blueprint order, Packet Tracer labs (walkthroughs plus downloadable baseline files), web flashcards, and mock exams for CCNP Security (SCOR 350-701 v2.0).
